question: Identify the economic infrastructure that supports financial activities such as stock trading, a variety of investments and deposits, funding initiatives, and loan remittances, both in India and globally.  (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (02/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Banking Institutions
Brokerage firms
Asset Management Companies(AMC)
Insurance sectors
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Banking Institutions

Explanation: Banking institutions are the backbone of financial infrastructure, supporting activities like stock trading, various investment and deposit schemes, funding initiatives, and loan remittances. They provide services such as accepting deposits, granting loans, payment services, and foreign exchange. In India, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulates these institutions. Banking institutions ensure liquidity and smooth functioning of the payment system in the economy. Globally, they facilitate international trade and investment. Commercial banks, central banks, and cooperative banks are primary types.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Who regulates banking institutions in India? → Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
☛ What is the primary function of banking institutions? → Accepting deposits and granting loans
☛ What is the largest bank in the world? → Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
☛ What is the largest public sector bank in India? → State Bank of India (SBI)
☛ What financial services do banking institutions provide? → Deposits, loans, payments, and remittances
question_hi: उस आर्थिक अवसंरचना की पहचान करें जो भारत और विश्व स्तर पर स्टॉक ट्रेडिंग, विभिन्न प्रकार के निवेश और जमा, वित्तपोषण पहल और ऋण प्रेषण जैसी वित्तीय गतिविधियों का समर्थन करती है। (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (02/12/2024) Shift 2)
options_hi: बैंकिंग संस्थान
दलाली फर्म
आस्ति प्रबंधन कंपनियां (AMC)
बीमा क्षेत्र
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है बैंकिंग संस्थान

Explanation: बैंकिंग संस्थान वित्तीय अवसंरचना का मुख्य स्तंभ हैं, जो स्टॉक ट्रेडिंग, विभिन्न निवेश और जमा योजनाएं, वित्तपोषण पहल, और ऋण प्रेषण जैसी गतिविधियों को समर्थन प्रदान करते हैं। ये संस्थान जमा स्वीकार करना, ऋण प्रदान करना, भुगतान सेवाएं, और विदेशी मुद्रा विनिमय जैसी सेवाएं प्रदान करते हैं। भारत में भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) इन संस्थानों का नियामक है। बैंकिंग संस्थान अर्थव्यवस्था में तरलता और भुगतान प्रणाली की सुचारू कार्यप्रणाली सुनिश्चित करते हैं। वैश्विक स्तर पर बैंकिंग संस्थान अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार और निवेश को सुविधाजनक बनाते हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT a private sector company in India? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Dabur
Tata Iron and Steel Company
Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
Bajaj Auto Limited
solution:

Explanation:
Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is a public sector undertaking (PSU) owned by the Government of India. It manufactures electrical equipment and is not considered a private sector company. In contrast, Dabur, Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO), and Bajaj Auto Limited are private sector companies. question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी भारत में एक निजी क्षेत्र की कंपनी नहीं है? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 3)
options_hi: डाबर
टाटा आयरन एंड स्टील कंपनी
भारत हेवी इलेक्ट्रिकल्स लिमिटेड

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है भारत हेवी इलेक्ट्रिकल्स लिमिटेड

Explanation:
भारत हेवी इलेक्ट्रिकल्स लिमिटेड (BHEL) एक सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का उपक्रम है, जो भारत सरकार के स्वामित्व में है। यह कंपनी विद्युत उपकरणों का निर्माण करती है और इसे निजी क्षेत्र की कंपनी नहीं माना जाता। इसके विपरीत, डाबर, टाटा आयरन एंड स्टील कंपनी (TISCO), और बजाज ऑटो लिमिटेड निजी क्षेत्र की कंपनियाँ हैं। डाबर एक उपभोक्ता वस्तु कंपनी है, टाटा स्टील इस्पात उद्योग में अग्रणी निजी कंपनी है, और बजाज ऑटो वाहन निर्माण में एक प्रमुख निजी कंपनी है। इस प्रकार, BHEL एक सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का उपक्रम है, निजी नहीं।

question: The Great Stupa at Sanchi is an important site in which religion? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Buddhism
Hinduism
Jainism
Islam
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Buddhism

Explanation:
The Great Stupa at Sanchi, located in Madhya Pradesh, is a prominent Buddhist monument. It was built by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE. This stupa is one of the three main sites of Buddhism and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The stupa enshrines relics of Lord Buddha, and its architecture features four gateways (toranas) in the north, south, east, and west, depicting Jataka tales and scenes from Buddha's life. This site has been a center for Buddhist pilgrimage and study.

☛ Which religion is the Sanchi Stupa associated with? → Buddhism
☛ Who built the Sanchi Stupa? → Emperor Ashoka
☛ In which state is the Sanchi Stupa located? → Madhya Pradesh
☛ What type of monument is the Sanchi Stupa? → Stupa
☛ Which organization declared Sanchi Stupa a World Heritage site? → UNESCO
question_hi: सांची का महान स्तूप किस धर्म से संबंधित महत्वपूर्ण स्थल है? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 3)

जैन धर्म
इस्लाम

Explanation:
सांची का महान स्तूप मध्य प्रदेश में स्थित एक प्रमुख बौद्ध स्मारक है। इसका निर्माण मौर्य सम्राट अशोक ने तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व में करवाया था। यह स्तूप बौद्ध धर्म के तीन मुख्य स्थलों में से एक है और यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल है। स्तूप में भगवान बुद्ध के अवशेष संरक्षित हैं, तथा इसकी वास्तुकला में उत्तरी, दक्षिणी, पूर्वी और पश्चिमी द्वार (तोरण) शामिल हैं, जो जातक कथाओं और बुद्ध के जीवन के दृश्यों को दर्शाते हैं। यह स्थान बौद्ध तीर्थयात्रा और अध्ययन का केंद्र रहा है।

question: In which language was the classic Indian novel 'Chandrakanta' originally written? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (17/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Bengali
Hindi
Tamil
Urdu
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hindi

Explanation:
Chandrakanta is a classic Indian novel written by Devaki Nandan Khatri. It was originally written in the Hindi language and is considered a significant work of Hindi literature. Chandrakanta is often regarded as the first Hindi novel, although it was not actually the first; however, it gained immense popularity and played a key role in popularizing Hindi prose literature. The novel was published in 1888 and contains elements of magic, adventure, and mystery.

question_hi: किस भाषा में क्लासिक भारतीय उपन्यास 'चंद्रकांता' मूल रूप से लिखा गया था? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (17/12/2024) Shift 2)

उर्दू

Explanation:
चंद्रकांता एक क्लासिक भारतीय उपन्यास है जिसे देवकीनंदन खत्री द्वारा लिखा गया था। यह उपन्यास मूल रूप से हिंदी भाषा में लिखा गया था और इसे हिंदी साहित्य का एक महत्वपूर्ण काम माना जाता है। चंद्रकांता को अक्सर पहला हिंदी उपन्यास माना जाता है, लेकिन यह वास्तव में पहला हिंदी उपन्यास नहीं था; हालांकि, यह बहुत लोकप्रिय हुआ और इसने हिंदी गद्य साहित्य को लोकप्रिय बनाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। यह उपन्यास 1888 में प्रकाशित हुआ था और इसमें जादू, रोमांच और रहस्य के तत्व शामिल हैं।

question: Which status was conferred upon Shipping Corporation of India (SCI) by the Government of India in August 2008? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (17/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Miniratna
Dashratna
Maharatna
Navratna
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Navratna

Explanation:
The Government of India conferred Navratna status upon the Shipping Corporation of India (SCI) in August 2008. This status is granted to Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) based on their excellent performance and autonomy. Navratna companies enjoy greater financial and managerial freedom at the board level. SCI is India's largest shipping company, involved in cargo and passenger transport, offshore services, and port operations. This status empowers the company with enhanced decision-making authority and investment capacity. Maharatna and Miniratna are other categories awarded to PSUs based on their size and performance.

question: What is one of the main attractions of ‘Mamallapuram’ apart from the dance festival? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (17/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Modern art galleries
Local handicrafts
Wildlife sanctuaries
Architectural beauty of temples
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Architectural beauty of temples

question: What is the name of the famous temple complex in Tamil Nadu, known for its Dravidian architecture and 1,000-pillar hall? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (17/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Brihadeeswarar Temple
Kanchipuram Temple
Jagannath Temple
Meenakshi Temple
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Meenakshi Temple

Explanation:

question: In South Indian temple architecture, what is the name of the stepped or pyramidal structure built above the sanctum? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (05/06/2025) Shift 1)
options: Adhisthana
Vimana
Jagati
Mandapa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Vimana

Explanation:
In South Indian temple architecture, the stepped or pyramidal structure built above the sanctum is called Vimana. The Vimana is the main tower of the temple, which gradually tapers upwards. In contrast, Adhisthana is the base or pedestal of the temple, Jagati is a platform or terrace, and Mandapa is a pillared hall. In the Dravidian style, the Vimana has various forms like Nagara, Vesara, and Dravida. It is constructed directly above the garbhagriha (sanctum) and marks the most sacred part of the temple. The height and design of the Vimana reflect the importance of the temple. The Vimana is distinct from the shikhara found in North Indian temples, which is also a superstructure but differs in shape and style.

question: Fiscal consolidation has remained a target of macroeconomic reforms. What was the targeted fiscal deficit as a percentage of GDP under the original FRBM Act 2003 ? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (14/06/2025) Shift 1)

.5%

question: The operating system UNIX is the trademark of ________. (RRB NTPC Tier I (02/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: Microsoft
Bell Laboratories
Apple
Motorola
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bell Laboratories

Explanation:
UNIX is a powerful multi-user and multi-tasking operating system, developed in 1969 at AT&T's Bell Laboratories by Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie. It was the first operating system written in the C language, making it highly portable. The trademark of UNIX originally belonged to Bell Laboratories. Later, it was transferred to The Open Group, which now holds the trademark and maintains the UNIX specification. UNIX has greatly influenced modern operating systems like Linux and macOS. Today, Bell Laboratories is known as Nokia Bell Labs.

question: With which state is the Nabakalebara festival associated? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 1)

Nabakalebara is a unique and grand spectacle in Hindu culture.
